headline: TruCap Finance announces unaudited financial results for Q2 FY27
hook: TruCap reports September quarter financial results
summary: TruCap Finance Limited has submitted its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. Retail investors can review these filings to assess the company's asset quality, loan book growth, and profitability trends over the first half of the financial year. Understanding these figures helps shareholders gauge the lender's operational performance in the NBFC segment.
why_it_matters: Quarterly metrics reveal the NBFC's loan growth and asset quality.

headline: Marwadi Chandarana Intermediaries submits open offer update for Trucap Finance
hook: Open offer update for Trucap Finance
summary: Sundae Capital Advisors has submitted an update on the open offer made by Marwadi Chandarana Intermediaries Brokers to shareholders of Trucap Finance. The filing provides procedural details regarding the ongoing acquisition process by the acquirer. Trucap Finance is the target company in this open offer transaction managed by Sundae Capital. Retail shareholders holding shares in Trucap Finance can review the update for details on the open offer timeline and procedure.
whats_next: Further open offer announcements from Sundae Capital
why_it_matters: Open offer terms update for Trucap Finance shareholders

headline: SAT extends stay on TruCap Finance open offer hearing
hook: Regulatory delay for TruCap Finance open offer
summary: The Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT) has extended the stay on the hearing regarding the open offer for TruCap Finance. This legal pause delays the resolution of the open offer process initiated for the company. The extension maintains the current status quo for shareholders involved in the transaction. Retail investors should note that this legal uncertainty may impact the timeline for liquidity or exit options related to the offer.
why_it_matters: Exit timeline for TruCap shareholders remains uncertain due to legal delays.

headline: TruCorp submits scrutinizers report and AGM voting results
hook: Voting results from the September annual meet
summary: TruCorp has officially filed its Scrutinizers' Report along with the voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. This routine corporate filing concludes the voting process on resolutions presented to shareholders at the meeting. For retail investors, such filings confirm whether standard resolutions like dividend approvals or director appointments were passed successfully. No extraordinary corporate actions or surprises were highlighted in the brief regulatory disclosure.
why_it_matters: Confirms shareholder approval status for company resolutions.
